name: Claude Cowork (agent mode in Claude desktop app)

versions_seen.version: claude-code 2.1.121 (in an April 2026 session audit log)

cocheck_relevance: Cowork runs Claude Code underneath with settingSources limited to user, so CoCheck's ~/.claude hooks do not reach it; today the observable channels are a per-session audit.jsonl (HMAC-signed, stream-json) and a per-session Claude Code transcript jsonl under Application Support, plus the file-system effects in the user-selected folders. No third-party hook channel is documented.

install.claim: Cowork ships inside the Claude desktop app (bundle id com.anthropic.claudefordesktop), an Electron app.
Desktop is available on macOS and Windows; Cowork is on paid plans; cloud sessions in beta for Team/Enterprise.
The official help page says Cowork work "runs on Anthropic's servers, in an isolated environment" (cloud sessions) and gives no VM or Linux detail; the Linux VM comes from the local bundle layout.

processes_and_paths.claim: Support dir ~/Library/Application Support/Claude holds local-agent-mode-sessions, vm_bundles (claudevm.bundle: rootfs.img, vmlinuz, initrd, sessiondata.img; ~9.9G), claude-code (bundled CLI by version), claude-code-vm, claude-code-sessions, claude_desktop_config.json, config.json.

Cowork runs a Linux VM (Apple Virtualization, with gVisor) booted via coworkd; logs: coworkd.log, cowork_vm_node.log, cowork_vm_swift.log, vzgvisor.log, swift.log, ssh.log in ~/Library/Logs/Claude. Host files are shared in via virtiofs mounts at /sessions/<vm>/mnt/.
processes_and_paths.note: mount path from shim.sh comment and log keywords virtiofs/Mounting; mount list not read in detail

processes_and_paths.claim: Third-party sources describe an isolated Linux VM on Apple's Virtualization Framework with only user-authorized folders reachable.
processes_and_paths.note: secondary source; the official help page says only 'isolated environment'

processes_and_paths.claim: Session metadata file local_ditto_<id>.json includes processName, vmProcessName, hostLoopMode, cwd, userSelectedFolders, model, egressAllowedDomains, pluginsEnabled, skillsEnabled, memoryEnabled, sessionType, systemPrompt (shape only read).
Plugin staging dir seen in session init: /var/folders/.../T/claude-hostloop-plugins/<hash> (source anthropic-skills@inline).

auth.claim: Account tokens are cached in config.json (oauth:tokenCache keys exist); not read.

available.claim: No documented user-facing hook channel for Cowork. The app spawns Claude Code with settingSources ["user"] and in-app PreToolUse hooks (e.g. matcher Task) set in code; user settings are inferred to resolve against the per-session .claude dir (not shown in code read), not ~/.claude.
available.note: inferred from minified code; not probed

config.claim: Bug report: plugin hooks/hooks.json never fire in Cowork (Windows) because the VM spawns claude with --setting-sources user; skills and MCP load fine. Fix status unknown.
config.note: only via search snippet; page fetch timed out

config.claim: Plugins in Cowork bundle skills, connectors, sub-agents (hooks not mentioned in the official help page); stored on the account.
The app binary contains disableAllHooks and PreToolUse strings (Claude Code SDK code); the session .claude dir observed had no settings.json.

missing_events.claim: No CoCheck-installable Pre/PostToolUse, UserPromptSubmit or Stop hook is known to run in Cowork sessions.

other_observation_channels.claim: Per-session audit.jsonl (HMAC-signed lines with _audit_hmac/_audit_timestamp, .audit-key beside it) records stream-json events: system init (tools, mcp_servers, plugins, claude_code_version, permissionMode), user, assistant, rate_limit_event, result (cost, usage, permission_denials).
other_observation_channels.note: keys only read; verified against one April session

other_observation_channels.claim: OpenTelemetry export (logs/events) for Cowork: prompts, tool/MCP calls, file access, skills/plugins, approval decisions, API requests; prompt.id links events of a prompt; content capture gated by otlpContentCapture device policy; Team/Enterprise admin-configured; needs Desktop >= 1.1.4173 (local).
other_observation_channels.note: admin feature; unclear if a local OTLP endpoint is usable on a personal plan

other_observation_channels.claim: Shim permission bridge dirs shim-perm/requests and shim-perm/responses per session (plugin CLI confirm protocol via shim.sh).
File-system effects of the agent appear in user-selected folders (mounted into the VM) and in session outputs/ and uploads/ dirs.
MCP: claude_desktop_config.json mcpServers and extensions feed session tools; logs mcp.log and mcp-server-<name>.log in ~/Library/Logs/Claude.

call_ids.claim: Tool calls in the transcript are Claude Code tool_use blocks (message.content[].type=tool_use with ids), same as Claude Code.
call_ids.note: All 13 tool_use blocks in audit.jsonl carry ids; transcript jsonl ids not checked.

narration_sources.name: assistant text and thinking blocks in transcript/audit
narration_sources.path: session .claude/projects/<slug>/<cli-session>.jsonl and audit.jsonl type=assistant, content types text, thinking, tool_use

fact.claim: Assistant text, thinking and tool_use blocks are written per message; user-facing narration also goes via SendUserMessage tool_use.

session_files.claim: Claude Code-format transcript per Cowork session at local_ditto_<id>/.claude/projects/<slug>/<uuid>.jsonl (types: user, assistant, attachment, queue-operation, last-prompt, ai-title).
Only one local_ditto session dir exists locally (April 2026); newer sessions' location not found; claude-code-sessions/ holds local_<uuid>.json metadata for desktop Claude Code sessions.
Docs: sessions and files are saved to the Claude account; cloud sessions run on Anthropic servers; local sessions need the app open.

helpers_or_subagents.claim: Subagents available in sessions: claude-code-guide, Explore, general-purpose, Plan, statusline-setup.

limits_and_timeouts.claim: Egress is restricted to an allowed-domain list per session (23 domains in the observed session).

update_channel.claim: App updates via Squirrel; bundled Claude Code versioned under Application Support/Claude/claude-code/<ver>.

open_questions: Does a live Cowork session honor hooks in the per-session CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR settings.json, and could CoCheck legitimately place them there?
Where do current (post-April) local Cowork sessions write audit.jsonl and transcripts? Only one old session dir found.
Is audit.jsonl written live per step, and can a third party verify or read it (HMAC key sits beside it)?
Is hostLoopMode the Claude CLI running on the Mac with tools executed in the VM, or the CLI inside the VM?
Can the OTel export be pointed at a local endpoint on non-Team plans (otlpContentCapture is a device policy)?
Status of issue 27398 (plugin hooks) on macOS 2.31226.1.
Exact virtiofs mount list and write-back timing for user folders.
